start: Owner in a browser that has used the admin app before; the admin app was updated since

steps.action: Open the admin app
user_sees: A number on the bell at the top right
must_not: A "What's new" card on Today pushing the page down
A number in the demo gym

steps.action: Tap the bell
user_sees: A group "What's new" with a short summary of the newest update, marked "New"
A link to see what's new
must_not: Updates not deployed yet
More than the newest update in the summary

steps.action: Tap the link
user_sees: The page "What's new": "Changes to the admin app, newest first. <version>."
One card per day, for example "17 Nov 2026"
must_not: An empty day card
Days out of order

steps.action: Go back and look at the bell
user_sees: No number for updates
must_not: The same updates counted again after they were opened

start: Other ways in: the last row of the left menu on a laptop, and More on a phone

steps.action: On a laptop tap "What's new" at the bottom of the left menu
user_sees: The page "What's new" with every update
The version beside the menu row
must_not: The row lying over "Help and feedback" on a 1366 x 768 window

steps.action: On a phone open More and tap "What's new" ("Changes to this admin app")
user_sees: The same page
must_not: A different list than on the laptop

steps.action: Tap the button on a line that has one
user_sees: The page that line talks about
must_not: A dead button
A page that does not exist any more

start: Owner; first visit, blocked storage, demo gym

steps.action: Open the admin app for the first time in a new browser, just after an update
user_sees: No number on the bell for updates
must_not: Old updates announced to a brand-new browser

steps.action: Open the admin app in a private window that blocks storage
user_sees: The admin app works; no update number
must_not: A crash or a blank page

steps.action: Open the demo gym
user_sees: No bell
must_not: Update news in the demo gym

start: Owner; updates seen, then two more deploys, then site data cleared

steps.action: Open the bell after one more update
user_sees: The newest update marked "New"; the number counts it once
must_not: Updates seen before marked "New" again

steps.action: Stay away for five updates, then open the admin app
user_sees: A number of at most 3 updates
must_not: Five or more counted
The oldest unseen shown instead of the newest

steps.action: Clear the browser's site data and open the admin app
user_sees: No update number (the browser only remembers the newest update again)
must_not: Every old update announced

steps.action: Open Settings or More and tap "What's new"
user_sees: The full list, whatever was seen
must_not: Seen updates removed from the list
